name: pricing
principle: Every hop copies the subtotal forward, and nothing between the route and the response asserts the total still holds.

hops.title: request enters the api
hops.note: the only route that creates an order, so every total in the platform starts here

hops.title: controller builds the order
hops.note: the subtotal enters the chain here and is copied forward untouched from this point on

hops.title: total resolution
hops.note: SOLE FUNNEL. every total the api returns is computed on this line, so it is the highest-leverage line in the chain

hops.title: tax applied
hops.note: the last hop that changes the number, and the only one that can lose a cent

invariants.statement: total(order) equals order.subtotal plus tax on that same subtotal, in whole cents
no path writes an order total without going through PriceCalculator::total

traps.what: the confirmation mail is queued before the response is built, so a total changed after that line is mailed as the old one
traps.anchor: the confirmation mail is queued here

traps.what: the observer refreshes a cached order summary on save, so a total written without a model event leaves a stale cache behind
traps.anchor: the order summary cache is refreshed here

moneyType.note: whole cents as an integer. never a float on a total, and never a rounded intermediate.
